rubrics.justification: Description is broadly consistent with a Day-5 2AB/full blastocyst, with plausible comments on compact ICM and looser TE; however, some image-specific details are somewhat inferential from a single still image and zona/hatching features were not clearly addressed.
Thoroughly integrates age, BMI, tubal factor diagnosis, ovarian reserve markers, prior IVF outcome, sperm parameters, endometrium, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, linking embryo grade and patient factors to prognosis; minor issues include slightly overstating 8.3 mm as borderline and giving a somewhat conservative implantation estimate for a 28-year-old with a 2AB embryo.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and aligned with common IVF practice, including preference for single embryo transfer and avoiding routine add-ons; small deviations include overemphasis on endometrial thickness concern and some speculative discussion of sperm DNA damage.

Provides practical next steps for transfer management and contingency planning, including SET, luteal support, cavity review, and selective further testing; useful though not highly protocol-specific.
